description: Mailbox inventory, selected-message expunge and Roundcube mailbox-name encoding settings.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 64.
Marks selected messages as deleted; rollback is none. Use getMailboxStatusList(account) separately to inventory mailbox names and GUIDs.

The required search query is sensitive and forwarded unchanged. The client does not parse, narrow or escape it, establish mailbox ownership, protect arbitrary mail from deletion, retry or roll back. Later live fixtures require separate ownership and cleanup.
Mailbox wildcard characters such as * cannot be escaped; upstream recommends expungeMessagesForMailboxGuid() instead.
The data member has an empty schema: any present JSON value, including null, is preserved as mixed. Missing data is a mismatch; no deletion count or per-message outcome is inferred.

Scalar identifiers and names are forwarded and form-encoded once without email, domain, path, UUID or search-query validation, trimming or UTF-8 name conversion. Optional and absent known fields remain distinct from explicit null. No live compatibility is established.
